items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: It was Erskine Hawkins' band. He's the guy that played that trumpet solo on 'Tuxedo Junction' that everybody has to copy.

ctx.x: Dud Bascomb, Doug Baskin, yeah. His father's name was Doug Baskin also. What band was he in?
It was Erskine Hawkins' band. He's the guy that played that trumpet solo on "Tuxedo Junction" that everybody has to copy.
Right. And his son is one of the most excellent fender base players, and also acoustical base players, and a fine young man. Excellent young man.
